spec.title: AI-Native Lean card F — Subject-bound diagnostics

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Keep the failed boundary and its relevant subject/source identity visible.

p.APPLICABILITY: A carrier, theorem, checker, toolchain or witness operation fails.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Runner/carrier diagnostics plus exact spec anchors and checker output.

p.SCOPE: The runner must distinguish failure from successful scoped proof. A general Lean conform/SARIF system is WISH.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: Raw Lean diagnostics aid proof repair; they do not by themselves bind a proof witness to a spec subject.

p.RISKS: A generic unavailable status can hide wrong subject or stale input; do not erase the failed invariant when mapping errors. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.

band-three.title: Band 3 — Operation
band-three.fence: trigger: WHEN A carrier, theorem, checker, toolchain or witness operation fails. mode: inline routine: 1. Identify the failed operation and subject. 2. Retain the checker or validation reason. 3. Follow the runner contract anchor. 4. Repair the responsible input, proof or configuration. 5. Rerun the exact bounded operation. checker: lean-ai-native --path . scan --carrier lean-proof.toml; lean-ai-native --path . check --carrier lean-proof.toml --subject <fully-qualified-subject> raid_role: layer=proof; order=after:independent-contract; batch=theorem budget: active_rules=1; first_signal=one targeted operation within its configured bound
